corrections.text: The article states 'Kitesurf took 1.7 to 1.8 times longer than Chromium to complete the same tasks, according to TechCrunch.' TechCrunch's article does not report this figure. The 1.7x-1.8x wall-clock slowdown is reported in Cloudflare's own announcement (blog.cloudflare.com/kitesurf/) and independently corroborated by MarkTechPost, not TechCrunch.
